sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 3x Vests, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Bodycam, 2x Radio.
Arrived at the office; completed debrief with night shift. Gearing up.
Heading towards Aotea Square for patrol with welfare checks on businesses.
Starbucks, Localito, Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience store all clear. Continuing towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing sweep.
Area all clear. Standby for presence.
Heading towards Federal St via Wellesley St.
Arrived at corner of Victoria and Federal St; welfare check on Eighty Fed and 77 Convenience store. Continuing to check surrounding businesses.
All businesses all clear. Standby for presence; spoke with a few passers-by about the cold morning.
Heading down towards Elliott and Darby St.
Elliott St and Darby St including Lumi Cafe all clear. Heading towards Library then Lorne St via Queen St and Wellesley St.
Library area and Lorne St all clear. Continuing through High St.
High St all clear. Heading through O'Connell St.
O'Connell St and Freyberg Square all clear. Heading towards Chancery for a sweep.
Area all clear at Chancery Square. Standby for presence.
Fort St, Fort Lane, Pocket Park, Wilson Carpark, Jo & Joe's, Right Track, Coffee Club and 77 Convenience store all clear. Continuing towards Gore St.
Gore St including Auckland Harbour Suites and Smiley Mart all clear. Standby for presence.
Heading towards Britomart via Customs St.
Welfare check Custom Mart Convenience store and Britomart McDonald's, all clear.
Full sweep around Commercial Bay, no issues. Standby for nearby calls.
Welfare check on Aotea Gifts, Remarkable Gifts and Albert Mart Convenience store, no issues.
Welfare check on Formery building, Sky Mart Convenience, City Convenience store, Grand Hotel and Wellesley St, all clear.
Full sweep around Aotea Square, no issues. Standby for nearby calls and showing presence.
Patrols down Queen Street with welfare checks along the way.
Welfare check on Chatime top of Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's, all clear.
Welfare check on Victoria St and top of High Street.
Full sweep around Freyberg area and Chancery Square, all clear.
Standby Freyberg Square for nearby calls and showing presence.
Patrol through O'Connell Street, bottom of High St, Fort St and White Lady, all clear.
Welfare check on Gore St and Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear.
Welfare check on Britomart and Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare check on carpark next to Chemist Warehouse, all clear.
Welfare check on Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive, all clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience store on Victoria Street, all clear.
Welfare check on Albert Mart Convenience store, all clear.
Welfare check on Customs St and Custom Mart Convenience store, all clear.
Welfare check on Fort Lane and Fort St (Jo & Joe), all clear.
Welfare check on High St and High Street Supermarket, all clear.
Welfare check on Chancery Square, Freyberg area and upper High Street, all clear.
Welfare check Lorne St and Auckland Library, all clear.
Received a call from Celine on Darby Street: a vagrant male trying to force his way into the store and refusing to leave the premises.
Arrived at Celine restaurant — Police were already at the scene. Stood by in front of Celine's providing security presence.
Patrolling up Victoria St, all clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience store, all clear.
Patrolling Federal St towards Wyndham Street, all clear.
Patrolling down Wyndham St towards Queen St, all clear.
Welfare check on Q Convenience store and Customs Mart, all clear.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort St and the bottom of High St, all clear.
Welfare check on High St Supermarket, all clear.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear.
Taking our 30-minute break; Ops Phone on charge (2%).
Standby in the office for response calls while Ops Phone charges (20%).

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:50 – 21:00)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Geared up; starting patrol on Queen St heading down towards Commercial Bay with welfare check-ins.
Welfare sweep on Lower Queen St, Freyberg and Chancery Square, Shortland St, Vulcan Lane and High St, no issues. Store checks:
Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, Vulcan Lane, Shortland St and Lower Queen St welfare sweep concluded, no issues. Continuing patrol to Commercial Bay.
Customs St no issues. Starting welfare sweep on Commercial Bay, Commerce and Tyler St.
Welfare sweeps complete; Commercial Bay no issues from public or stores.
Tyler St and Commerce St complete, no issues. Heading to Gore and Fort St.
Gore St welfare check complete, no issues:
No issues. Heading through Queen St via Customs St towards Albert St.
Albert St no issues; welfare check on Albert Mart, clear. Heading to the Cathedral.
The Cathedral welfare sweep complete, no issues. Heading to Victoria St via Federal St.
Victoria St sweep clear; welfare checks on stores complete. Heading down to Elliott St.
Elliott St / Darby sweep clear; welfare check on Elliott Stables clear. Making our way to Aotea Square.
Full sweep on Aotea Square complete, no issues; mild foot traffic. Returning to Queen St for welfare checks.
Welfare checks on Upper Queen St complete, no issues:
Lorne St sweep complete, no issues; welfare check on Radisson Red, clear.
All sweeps and welfare checks complete, no issues or calls. Heading back onto Queen St to maintain presence.
No calls or issues. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone (low).
Guard standing down; debrief with handover guard complete, no issues. Guards will continue to report until 22:00.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ; guard clocking off, standby for second guard to arrive.
Check-in Queen St Macca's, Localito, Avachi and 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, no issues.
Patrolling Lorne St, all clear. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone.
On standby at HQ charging Ops Phone.
Welfare check McDonald's Queens, Timezone Centre, Cha Cha Panda, 77 Convenience store, Cue Ball 8 and other open businesses, no issues. Heading up to Aotea Square for a sweep.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing full sweep, lots of foot traffic, welfare-checking the public.
Full sweep Aotea Square complete. Walking down Mayoral Drive heading to Elliott Street to welfare check Bar 101.
Arrived at Elliott Street; heading to Bar 101 showing presence due to crowding.
Full sweep Elliott Street / Darby Street; welfare check Bar 101, all clear. Patrolling up Victoria Street West.
Welfare check Victoria Street West and 77 Convenience store, all clear. Patrolling down Federal St.
Full sweep Cathedral, Liston House and Federal St; welfare check Ace Karaoke Bar, all clear. Walking down Wyndham St to Queen Street.
Full sweep Wyndham Street, no issues. Heading up Queen Street back to HQ for floor checks.
Welfare check Localito store, all clear. Heading to HQ for floor checks.

Full sweep Fort Lane, Fort Street and Shortland Street; welfare check Shortland Mart, Evan's Kebabs and KFC, all clear. Standby at Sapphire Nightclub due to large numbers of male delinquents in the area.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, all clear. Patrolling down to Britomart.
Full sweep Britomart centre; welfare check McDonald's and guard. Not much foot traffic; continuing patrols.
Welfare check Kemuri guard and Reign n Pour, all clear.

Received a text from a fellow associate at Sapphire: a large number of male delinquents (possibly gang affiliated) heading to Britomart for a suspected brawl. Making our way down to show presence and minimise public risk.
Arrived at Britomart; standby showing presence and welfare-checking the public.
Stood down at Britomart — no violent altercations seen. Welfare check Britomart McDonald's. Making our way to Bar 101.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, all clear. Making our way to Bar 101 through Queen Street.
Arrived at Bar 101; standby showing presence, very large foot traffic, standing by till closing.
Encountered two male individuals going off at each other in front of Bar 101; approached and separated them, no further issues.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear. Continuing patrols.
Sweep Darby St / Elliott St, all clear. Patrolling up Victoria Street.
Sweep Victoria Street West; welfare check 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Full sweep Federal St; check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church and Liston House, all clear.
Full sweep Wyndham St, all clear. Heading down Queen Street to Britomart.
Welfare check Britomart Macca's / Commercial Bay, all clear.
Completed check Fort St / Wilson Carpark, all clear. Patrolling up High Street to Freyberg for a full sweep.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square, all clear.
Swept corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear. Patrolling up to Aotea Square.
Full sweep Aotea Square, all clear, no foot traffic. Heading down Queen Street to welfare check McDonald's.
Welfare check Queen St Macca's, no issues. Heading to HQ to commence break and standby for handover.
Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
